title: TechDev #97 Final Adjudication
question: Did the frozen June 29 TechDev #97 claims about September ETH/BTC breakout, rotation and DeFi/Aave leadership survive their original validation and failure criteria?
hypothesis: Some structural elements may have been directionally useful, but the time-specific breakout/leadership claims must be judged strictly against the frozen criteria without moving goalposts.
baseline: Original June 29 frozen claim package and only evidence available through the completed evaluation window, scored claim-by-claim.
required_analysis: Recover and preserve every frozen claim and its original validation/failure criteria.
Evaluate BTC/ETH bottom claims, ETH/BTC higher-low/breakout sequence, BTC.D behavior, breadth, DeFi/Aave leadership and timing window separately.
Distinguish beta/oversold rebound from genuine leading information.
Record partial credit only where criteria explicitly allow it.
Do not use later narrative to rescue a failed September timing claim.
falsifier: The article's apparently successful elements fail their own frozen timing/sequence criteria or add no lead over simpler market evidence.
kill_condition: Close the shadow item after adjudication. Retain only reusable mechanisms supported by frozen evidence; no permanent open-ended rescue window.
